# V2EX Starter Template

> A Next.js and Solana starter template for wallet connection, V2EX or SOL payments, V2EX balance queries, transaction inspection, message signing, and backend signature verification.

## Canonical Pages

- [Home](https://v2ex.becool.dev/) - Chinese demo page and token facts.
- [English home](https://v2ex.becool.dev/en) - English demo page and token facts.
- [FAQ](https://v2ex.becool.dev/faq) - Chinese answers for common implementation questions.
- [English FAQ](https://v2ex.becool.dev/en/faq) - English answers for common implementation questions.
- [Changelog](https://v2ex.becool.dev/changelog) - User-facing page updates.

## Project Facts

- Project name: V2EX Starter Template.
- Repository: https://github.com/becoolme/v2ex-starter-template.
- Token: V2EX, a Solana SPL Token.
- Token contract address: 9raUVuzeWUk53co63M4WXLWPWE4Xc6Lpn7RS9dnkpump.
- Token explorer: https://solscan.io/token/9raUVuzeWUk53co63M4WXLWPWE4Xc6Lpn7RS9dnkpump.
- Network: Solana Mainnet Beta.
- Token decimals: 6.
- Recommended production RPC: a private Solana RPC from providers such as Alchemy, QuickNode, or Helius.

## API Examples

- GET /api/balance/[address] returns the V2EX balance for a Solana address.
- GET /api/transaction/[signature] returns parsed V2EX or SOL transaction details when available.
- POST /api/verify-signature verifies a wallet signature from message, signature, and publicKey.

## Safety Boundary

This project is a developer example, not investment advice. Do not connect a primary wallet or assets you cannot risk to a demo site.
